data.template.narx-pending:
github:
  repoURLPath: "{{.app.spec.source.repoURL}}"
  revisionPath: "{{.app.status.sync.revision}}"
  status:
    state: pending
    label: 'narx/deploy-{{index .app.metadata.labels "delivery.narx.space/environment"}}'
data.trigger.narx-pending:
- description: Commerce pending deployment evidence
  oncePer: "app.status.sync.revision + ':' + app.status.operationState.startedAt + ':' + (app.status.health.lastTransitionTime ?? '')"
  send: [narx-pending]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil && app.status.operationState.phase == 'Running'
data.template.narx-healthy:
github:
  repoURLPath: "{{.app.spec.source.repoURL}}"
  revisionPath: "{{.app.status.sync.revision}}"
  status:
    state: success
    label: 'narx/deploy-{{index .app.metadata.labels "delivery.narx.space/environment"}}'
data.trigger.narx-healthy:
- description: Commerce healthy deployment evidence
  oncePer: "app.status.sync.revision + ':' + app.status.operationState.startedAt + ':' + (app.status.health.lastTransitionTime ?? '')"
  send: [narx-healthy]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil && app.status.operationState.phase == 'Succeeded' && app.status.sync.status == 'Synced' && app.status.health.status == 'Healthy'
data.template.narx-failed:
github:
  repoURLPath: "{{.app.spec.source.repoURL}}"
  revisionPath: "{{.app.status.sync.revision}}"
  status:
    state: failure
    label: 'narx/deploy-{{index .app.metadata.labels "delivery.narx.space/environment"}}'
data.trigger.narx-failed:
- description: Commerce failed deployment evidence
  oncePer: "app.status.sync.revision + ':' + app.status.operationState.startedAt + ':' + (app.status.health.lastTransitionTime ?? '')"
  send: [narx-failed]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil && (app.status.operationState.phase in ['Error', 'Failed'] || app.status.health.status == 'Degraded')
data.service.webhook.slack:
url: $narx-slack-webhook
headers:
  - name: Content-Type
    value: application/json
data.template.narx-slack-deployed:
webhook:
  slack:
    method: POST
    body: |
      {"text":"[DEPLOYED] Narx {{index .app.metadata.labels "delivery.narx.space/environment"}} | {{.app.metadata.name}} | Git {{.app.status.sync.revision}}"}
data.trigger.narx-slack-deployed:
- description: Narx deployed delivery summary
  oncePer: app.status.operationState.startedAt
  send: [narx-slack-deployed]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil && app.status.operationState.phase == 'Succeeded' && app.status.sync.status == 'Synced' && app.status.health.status == 'Healthy' && app.status.summary != nil && app.status.summary.images != nil && len(app.status.summary.images) > 0
data.template.narx-slack-failed:
webhook:
  slack:
    method: POST
    body: |
      {"text":"[SYNC FAILED] Narx {{index .app.metadata.labels "delivery.narx.space/environment"}} | {{.app.metadata.name}} | Git {{.app.status.sync.revision}}"}
data.trigger.narx-slack-failed:
- description: Narx failed delivery summary
  oncePer: app.status.operationState.startedAt
  send: [narx-slack-failed]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil && app.status.operationState.phase in ['Error', 'Failed']
